bundle.shortDescription: A native GUI for omp agents running in herdr
bundle.longDescription: TeleFlock shows every omp agent running inside herdr on a live board, lets you answer, steer and review them, and drops into a real terminal when you need it. Connects over Tailscale SSH, to herdr on this PC, or inside WSL.
